file_impact.reason: Change 2 (group-classification core): replace the blanket `FallbackExceptionGroup -> CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL` arm in `_map` with `_classify_fallback_group`, which aggregates an EXHAUSTED chain by its MOST-RECOVERABLE leg — a retryable leg (WAIT_AND_RETRY/RETRY_NOW) on ANY candidate wins, so a fallback leg's non-retryable failure can no longer mask a retryable primary throttle as INDETERMINATE. All-non-retryable groups keep CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL. Classifier stays TOTAL. Inherited by every gate surface at the single `interpret_failure`/preflight seam.

Change 1 (leg marker, REUSED seam — Option B): the EXISTING per-candidate wrapper `_TracedCandidateModel` (already applied to every leg by build_fallback_model, already carrying `_candidate_order`, already catching in `request()`) now stamps `_FALLBACK_LEG_ATTR` on a raised exception when `_candidate_order > 0`. Adds the `_FALLBACK_LEG_ATTR` constant + `is_fallback_leg_failure(exc)` reader. No new parallel wrapper stack.

Change 1 consumer: `should_fall_back` gains an early `if is_fallback_leg_failure(exc): return True` (from rebar.llm.tracing) so a NON-PRIMARY leg's failure is always retained into the FallbackExceptionGroup instead of pydantic-ai bare-reraising the terminal leg and discarding the primary's retained cause; the PRIMARY (order 0, unstamped) keeps the deliberately narrow guard unchanged. Two-rule docstring. (Net -59 LOC: the earlier separate `_FallbackLegModel` wrapper + 3 helpers + double-wrap are removed in favour of the reused tracing seam.)

NEW held-out oracle (4 tests): (1) end-to-end through the real `build_fallback_model` + real `should_fall_back` — a throttled ModelHTTPError(429) primary behind a keyless-auth-TypeError fallback surfaces as exit-11 retryable (WAIT_AND_RETRY), not INDETERMINATE; (2) direct classifier — a group of [retryable 429, non-retryable TypeError] classifies retryable; (3) order-independence; (4) over-broadening guard — an all-non-retryable group stays CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL. Asserts observable disposition/exit only.
